summary: A humorous, flowery company-policy introduction from GlobalUnitySolutions, Inc. announcing its AntiDiscrimination and Anti-Harassment Measures. It covers the company's stance against bias and harassment, a whistleblower reporting process with anonymity, training sessions, and a pledge to build a diverse, harmonious workforce.
one_line: GlobalUnitySolutions, Inc. introduces its tongue-in-cheek anti-discrimination and anti-harassment policy covering reporting, anonymity, training, and a diversity pledge.
key_facts: GlobalUnitySolutions, Inc. introduces its AntiDiscrimination and Anti-Harassment Measures, described as 'corporate scripture'.
The company says discrimination is as ludicrous as a rotary phone in a smartphone convention.
Discriminators will be 'promptly encouraged to join our history books', alongside sympathizers of geocentricism and advocates for the spork.
The company claims a diverse, multinational, multilingual, multi-talented personnel panel will ensure discrimination is rare.
Harassers will be escorted by the Governance Gendarmerie to a private showing of 'How Not to Be a Nincompoop: The Movie.'
GlobalUnitySolutions is implementing the 'Golden Rule Plus', which means treating others with respectful awe.
Misconduct reporting is portrayed as a 'full-blown aria in front of the assembled cast', yet anonymity will be upheld.
The note jokes that the secret ingredient in the break room coffee is respect.
The company offers training sessions on discrimination and harassment, compared to a speed-dating event that sparks enlightenment instead of romance.
The pledge is to curate employees as assorted and harmonious as the United Nations, as if hosting an international potluck every Friday.
The company envisions a future where children ask 'What was discrimination?'
